The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a craft-able resource, the only purpose of which is the building of [[stone columbarium]]s, which increases your graveyard rating by 12 {{Graveyard Rating}} once they're constructed. Note that the urn cannot be broken down, thus the materials used in the crafting are permanently consumed.
